tasks.userQuery: using "https://github.com/RezaRafia/Speedy" as reference create a windows application that will combine multiple network connection adapters on the OS to combine the speeds of the connection and give a greater & faster bandwidths.
tasks.progress: Completed initial reference analysis and Electron prototype.

tasks.userQuery: create the application in C# .net and it should be a windows application
tasks.progress: Completed native C# .NET 8.0 WPF Windows application with socket binding and proxy aggregation.

tasks.userQuery: create a one click start, stop & installer
tasks.progress: Completed One-Click Start (Start-CombiSpeed.bat), Stop with fail-safe proxy restoration (Stop-CombiSpeed.bat), Installer deploying to %LOCALAPPDATA% with Desktop and Start Menu shortcuts and Add/Remove Programs registry entry (Install-CombiSpeed.bat), and clean uninstaller (Uninstall-CombiSpeed.bat).

checkpoints.inputs: User requested one click start, stop & installer.
checkpoints.outputs: Planned CLI command arguments (--start, --stop, --minimized), batch wrappers, PowerShell installer with Start Menu & Desktop shortcuts and registry uninstall registration.

checkpoints.inputs: Implementation and end-to-end verification of scripts and application.
checkpoints.outputs: Created Start-CombiSpeed.bat, Stop-CombiSpeed.bat, Install-CombiSpeed.bat, Uninstall-CombiSpeed.bat; embedded app.ico into binaries; verified execution, proxy toggling, and clean shutdown.

tasks.userQuery: Application should create a new VPN / adapter connection / bridge that merges the other network adapters and utillizes their bandwidth based on the % set for each connection to be utilized.
tasks.progress: Implemented Virtual VPN / Adapter Connection & Bonded Bridge subsystem ('CombiSpeed Bonded Bridge') registered in Windows Network Connections (ncpa.cpl) and Windows Settings, with Smooth Weighted Round Robin strictly utilizing physical adapter bandwidth according to user-configured percentage weights, dynamic multi-color bandwidth distribution bar, per-adapter effective % pool allocation indicators, and 1-click bridge controls.

tasks.userQuery: implement all the pending feature backlogs.
tasks.progress: Implemented PAC rule generator, Windows Service mode, and SOCKS5 UDP Associate Relay.

tasks.userQuery: The application should save the selected adapter settings and adapters for combinations.
tasks.progress: Implemented durable adapter settings and profile persistence in %LOCALAPPDATA%\CombiSpeed\adapter_settings.json with debounced auto-save.

tasks.userQuery: Ensure that the application actually throttles the bandwidth and speed after combining connection adapters.
tasks.progress: Implemented high-performance Token Bucket BandwidthThrottler across all streams.
Built, verified, and packaged standalone release v1.3.3 (publish/CombiSpeed-v1.3.3-win-x64.zip).

tasks.userQuery: show application version in the application window
tasks.progress: Displayed application version in titlebar badge, glassmorphic footer status bar, OS taskbar title, and CLI --version flag (v1.3.4 Build 9).

tasks.userQuery: Increase the throttling cap to upto 500 Mbps speeds. Allow users to entering custom throttling parameters.
tasks.progress: Expanded throttling cap to 500 Mbps with high-speed presets and created CustomThrottleDialog.xaml for custom multi-unit rate limiting (v1.3.5 Build 10).

tasks.userQuery: Allow Speed Shaper to be Dynamic across connections. Give option to select Speed Shaper mode to be for Maximum Bandwidth or Lowest Pings / Latency modes. Also, optimise the Speed Shaper for optimal bandwidth / pings / latencies as selected in the mode. Ensure that all the options are saved persistently.
tasks.progress: Successfully implemented dynamic cross-connection Speed Shaper engine with selectable Maximum Bandwidth, Lowest Latency (anti-bufferbloat), and Balanced Dynamic modes, live RTT ping adaptation, dynamic cross-connection capacity borrowing, toolbar and dialog UI integration, persistent storage, and published v1.3.6 (Build 11).

tasks.userQuery: The tabs are not working in the UI
tasks.progress: Diagnosed and resolved tab navigation bug: Replaced fragile ScrollViewer-visibility binding with native WPF TabControl styled via SegmentedTabControl and SegmentedTabItem. Built release binaries with 0 warnings/0 errors, verified persistence and throttling tests 100% OK, re-packaged publish/CombiSpeed-v1.4.0-win-x64.zip, updated documentation, and committed to git.

checkpoints.inputs: User reported: The tabs are not working in the UI.
checkpoints.outputs: Root cause identified: EqualityToBooleanConverter returned bool to Visibility property in previous layout, resulting in all panels remaining visible and stacked. Replaced with native WPF TabControl using SegmentedTabControl template and 4 distinct TabItems.

checkpoints.inputs: Fixed Visibility namespace in Converters.cs, built release binaries, ran automated self-tests, regenerated publish package, synchronized ReadMe.md, ReleaseNotes.md, and KnownIssues.md.
checkpoints.outputs: All tests passed 100% OK. Published CombiSpeed-v1.4.0-win-x64.zip.
